VibeCraft by Tront

VibeCraft is a voxel terrain chunker written in vanilla JavaScript: generate the world, mesh it in web workers so the main thread keeps drawing, and walk around in it. It is the terrain half of a Minecraft clone rather than the whole game.

One page, no install. By Tront (Trent Sterling). The finished voxel game is CraftMine next door.

More from Tront

  • Terrain Lab: Streamed, editable Surface Nets terrain sandbox: carve, build, plant forests, wake volcanoes, dig up a fossil.
  • VIXELS: Vector materials for voxel surfaces: contours in data textures evaluated in the shader, so you can zoom forever.
